what: The plan relies on unchanged pause/load, but pause snapshots keep .pause-requested.
scenario_or_breakage: After the proposed Step 2a fence writes step-1c, step-1d, step-1d.5, and step-1e before the pause-check, design-pause-save publishes the snapshot before removing .pause-requested. design-log-publish includes .pause-requested for --reason pause, and design-pause-load restores it without clearing. Resume can route through 1d.7 via .outline-approved, but Step 2a then immediately sees the restored .pause-requested and pauses again instead of continuing.
suggested_fix: Keep the routing fold, but add the minimum pause-resume fix: clear .pause-requested after a successful restore in design-pause-load.sh, or exclude it from pause snapshots for --reason pause. Add a focused pause-resume harness case for four discussion sentinels plus .outline-approved so the resume reaches Step 2a once instead of re-pausing.
